newsitem.title: UK: Air Foyle may set up new passenger airline.
newsitem.headline: Air Foyle may set up new passenger airline.

text.p: UK independent carrier Air Foyle is set to enter an agreement to form a new joint venture passenger airline, chairman Chris Foyle told Reuters.
He said that this would call for Air Foyle, an unnamed UK tour operator and an individual financier to take equal shares in the new stand-alone company.
"The plan would be for the new company to acquire or lease aircraft at its own risk and then operate them on behalf of others on wet-lease or time-charter contracts," he said.

Foyle said this would represent a departure from Air Foyle's normal business policy, under which the primarily cargo specialist carrier operates and/or manages aircraft for another company which owns the planes.
"This is a passenger project, although cargo may be included at some stage...this has yet to be decided," said Foyle.
"The three parties concerned are in the final stages of entering an agreement," he said.
The initial idea is to acquire two passenger Airbus A300s on long-term leases, Foyle added. - Bob Murphy, Reuters Air Cargo Newsroom Tel+44 171 542 7706; Fax +5017
